patterns.name: Mode tables and scene helpers have separate responsibilities
patterns.claim: gmvsmode.c binds CSS, SSS, ordinary match, Sudden Death and Results callbacks and payloads. gmvsmelee.c implements shared preparation. Ordinary and Sudden Death reuse the start buffer but have different exit records. EnterVs invokes its whole-match callback before copying players, then invokes per-player callbacks after all copies. File prefixes locate related code; the actual table establishes ownership and sharing.
